import numpy as np
    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError(f"tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number, got boolean")
    if not (isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) and np.isfinite(tau_filter) and tau_filter >= 0):
        raise ValueError(f"tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized future-token weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw = np.maximum(0., 1. - 0.2 * t)
    sum_raw = np.sum(raw)
    if sum_raw > 0:
        weights = raw / sum_raw
    else:
        weights = raw

    # Weighted losses
    L_with_result = -np.sum(weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # Margin and keep
    margin = L_minus - L_with_result
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
